environment.competingLoad: HoloGPU captures are serialized. Independent user projects may be active; machine-wide load is not controlled.

method: Actual launch page, all viewport-intersecting attachments rendered every sampled frame, including interaction-only fields and the ordinarily rate-limited grain. 30 warmup plus 120 samples per section, seed 7, authored resolution scales, actual CSS/input hooks, shared session submit, queue completion awaited each frame. Scheduler is stopped during this manual capture. Completed-work is CPU encode+submit+GPU queue callback, not pure GPU execution or compositor presentation. Initial attachment timings retained separately. This measures the 4ms completed-work page gate; it does not establish individual pure-GPU timing gates.
